policy: Shared compatibility policy and owned-process class for internal runner and future outer observer; cmd is not on the general executable allowlist.
Exact System32 command, strict /C argument form, live owned pinned Ninja identity and CMake configure/compile ancestry.
Matching working directories inside the new build subtree; bounded generated build.ninja and CMakeFiles/rules.ninja references; changed recipes and alternate build-file arguments rejected.
Fixed trusted sources only; native input paths reject shell control and expansion characters.
Read-only HKCU/HKLM AutoRun in the native 64-bit view must be absent or empty; no registry settings are modified.
Rejected identities remain owned for cleanup; original runtime class is restored and primary errors preserved.

independent_ai_review.scope: Source delta and saved evidence only; no test/native replay.

limitations: Actual Windows build and generated recipe handling still require verification.
Future external observer must use the same shared policy and class.
No model-quality, human-review or public-deployment acceptance.
